result.blocker: Make's affiliate program has no standalone public application form. Per Make's own Help Center: 'Anyone with a Make account can become an affiliate' - enrollment is done entirely from inside a logged-in Make account (profile icon > Affiliate program > choose an affiliate code, enter Wise payout email/account type/currency, complete a short survey, and agree to ToS). The marketing page's 'Get started' link (make.com/user/affiliate) redirects straight to the Make login/signup page. This requires creating or logging into a Make account first, which falls under the 'Creating accounts' prohibition - an action butler cannot take even with standing authorization. No application was attempted, matching how apply-framer.json was handled for the same structural reason.
result.notes: 큰형: to enroll COSHUMA in Make's affiliate program, please log into (or create) a Make account yourself, then go to your profile icon > Affiliate program, choose a unique affiliate code (5-20 chars, lowercase, can't be changed later), and provide a Wise email/account type/payout currency for receiving commissions. Let butler know if you'd like help drafting the short survey answers once you're in the flow.
